name: Matthew M.
preview: Sarah: What else are you running, and where'd you pick it up?

messages.text: Hey, Matthew. Thanks for picking up. I'm Sarah, an AI researcher, reaching out on behalf of Helium Deploy. This should take about 15 minutes. And as a thank you for your time, you'll get a 75 dollar store credit at the end. No right or wrong answers. Just share whatever comes to mind. So I can see you've got 18 orders with HD, which is pretty serious. And your latest 1 is a couple of NerdCacks plus plus rev 6 point ones from late April. I'm curious. What does your full setup look like right now? It all HD purchases, or do you have gear from other places too?
I have gear from other places.
What else are you running, and where'd you pick it up?
